# Innondu

> Innondu (ಇನ್ನೊಂದು, Kannada for "one more") is a small rewards web app for neighbourhood shops. It gives shops digital stamp cards, a daily scratch card and offers that customers use in their phone browser. Nothing to install, and it works alongside the shop's existing billing system.

## Pages
- [Home](https://www.innondu.com/): what Innondu does, live stamp demo, owner dashboard preview, FAQ
- [For cafés](https://www.innondu.com/for-cafes/): how Innondu works in a café
- [About](https://www.innondu.com/about/): why it was built and what it believes
- [Contact](https://www.innondu.com/contact/): tell us about your shop; replies within a day

## Guides

- [11 loyalty program ideas for small shops that bring people back](https://www.innondu.com/blog/loyalty-program-ideas-small-shops/)

## Key facts
- Customers: join with a phone number, collect stamps by tapping an NFC tag or scanning a QR code, claim rewards and offers.
- Owners: customer list, one-tap WhatsApp messages, menu, redeem codes, offers.
- A free NFC stamp and a QR poster are provided to every shop; a branded 3D stand is optional.
- Built by Aryan Swaroop (https://aryanswaroop.com).
